♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Sun and Moon both in Virgo today, your 6th house of work, systems and self-discipline is strongly lit from a Vedic perspective. Hasta nakshatra brings a ‘craftsman’ mood: you’re meant to shape something with your own hands and skill. Mars and Jupiter still move through Cancer in your 4th house, stirring the emotional foundations underneath your routine. You may feel an urge to clean up your schedule, your space and even the way you carry stress in your body.

💼 Career: This is a day for method, not drama. The double Virgo emphasis over your 6th makes checklists, process improvements and practical problem-solving unusually effective. You can catch small errors others miss and quietly fix them. Mars–Jupiter in your 4th suggest that frustrations at home or with family can bleed into work if you don’t create boundaries. If you work from home, rearranging your desk or setting clearer work hours can noticeably lift your productivity.

❤️ Love: With your 7th lord Venus still retrograde in Libra in your 7th from the sidereal view, relationships are in a review phase, but today the focus shifts to how everyday habits support (or erode) connection. Simple things—keeping a promise about time, following through on a small task you said you’d handle—speak louder than big declarations. If single, you may feel drawn to people whose lives are well-organised and who respect your time; pay attention to that preference.

💰 Money: Virgo’s influence on your 6th house highlights expenses tied to work, health, and daily functioning: tools, subscriptions, transport, minor repairs. This is an excellent day to prune recurring costs and streamline how money flows out of your account. Rahu in Aquarius in your 11th can tempt you toward impulsive “future investment” purchases through friends or online communities; pause and run numbers before agreeing.

🧘 Advice: Treat today like a quiet reset of your systems. Small, unglamorous adjustments in routine can free up more energy than a heroic push.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your everyday life stops leaking energy, your natural Aries fire becomes something you can actually aim.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon travel together in Virgo in your 5th house of creativity, joy and personal expression. Hasta nakshatra gives skilled hands and the desire to make something tangible from your ideas. Meanwhile, your ruler Venus is retrograde in Libra in your 6th, turning your attention to how pleasure and discipline are mixed in your daily life. Jupiter and Mars in Cancer continue to activate your 3rd house, keeping your mind busy and your calendar dotted with short tasks and trips.

💼 Career: This is a good day for work that involves design, teaching, planning content, or shaping something that carries your particular style. The 5th-house activation favours showcasing a talent—even if only in a small meeting or internal project. With Venus retrograde in the 6th, you may see where you’ve made your workday aesthetically pleasing but structurally cluttered. It’s a good moment to remove tasks that don’t truly need you, so you can give your best to what does.

❤️ Love: The 5th house emphasis warms the heart, but not in an overly sentimental way. You may crave interactions that feel playful and mentally engaging, rather than heavy talks. If partnered, planning a simple shared activity—cooking together, a small creative project, a game night—can refresh intimacy without needing big conversations. If single, attraction may spark with someone around hobbies, learning spaces, or through your local environment; their practical intelligence will appeal more than surface charm.

💰 Money: The Virgo energy over your 5th is not about wild speculation; it’s about consciously choosing where you want to invest joy. Spending on classes, tools for a hobby, or children can be fulfilling if you keep it modest and well-planned. Mars–Jupiter in your 3rd can bring extra fuel costs, commuting expenses or tech purchases; choose the options that truly support your productivity, not just what’s trendy.

🧘 Advice: Notice which activities make you lose track of time in a good way, and which leave you subtly drained. Today’s sky supports reorganising your schedule around that difference.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you treat your creativity as a real responsibility, life starts paying you back in more than just compliments.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: Sun and Moon conjoin in Virgo in your 4th house, putting a spotlight on the emotional climate of your home and inner world. Hasta nakshatra brings a mood of rearranging, fixing and refining: you may feel compelled to adjust furniture, sort cupboards, or tidy digital files just to feel mentally clearer. Mercury, your ruler, sits in Libra in Swati in your 5th, encouraging diplomatic self-expression once your base feels secure. Jupiter and Mars in Cancer keep financial questions humming in the background.

💼 Career: While this isn’t necessarily the most extroverted workday, it can be deeply productive if you focus on background structures. Updating files, improving a system, or quietly preparing a presentation or proposal can go remarkably smoothly. The condition of your workspace—especially at home—will strongly influence your focus; even a brief declutter can sharpen your thinking. If you have a hybrid or remote setup, consider how boundaries between family and work time can be made cleaner.

❤️ Love: With your 4th house activated, you’re more aware of how safe and understood you feel with others. If partnered, smaller gestures around domestic life—sharing chores fairly, respecting each other’s need for quiet, making a corner of the home more nurturing—will matter more than dramatic romantic statements. If single, you may feel less like socialising and more like nurturing yourself; that’s not withdrawal, it’s a recharge. Conversations can move toward childhood patterns and what “home” really means to you.

💰 Money: Mars–Jupiter in Cancer in your 2nd keep income and assets active, but today’s Virgo focus suggests your best move is to know exactly what you own and owe. Go over accounts, subscriptions, and automatic payments with a precise eye. Small leaks are more visible now. You don’t need radical changes—just accurate numbers and perhaps one or two concrete adjustments.

🧘 Advice: Think of your inner climate as a room you can rearrange. Even one deliberate change in your space or routine can shift your mood significantly today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your mind is sharpest when your heart feels at home; honour the spaces that give you that feeling.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: With the Sun and Moon joining in Virgo in your 3rd house, your mental field is active and precise. Hasta’s influence makes you want to not only talk but also implement—turning ideas into tangible steps. Mars and Jupiter traveling through your own sign keep your physical energy relatively high, though you could feel pulled in many directions. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 9th keeps you quietly questioning the bigger story behind your choices.

💼 Career: This is a day of emails, calls, errands, and details—but also of gaining leverage through organisation. The 3rd-house activation supports writing, editing, scheduling, and closing loops that have been lingering. Your words carry weight now, especially in practical discussions. With Mars and Jupiter in your 1st, you might be tempted to say yes to everything; instead, use Virgo’s discrimination to sort what truly matters. Short trainings or quick skill upgrades are especially favoured.

❤️ Love: Communication is the main channel for connection today. If partnered, you may find yourselves discussing daily plans, travel, siblings, or neighbours more than deep emotions—and that’s fine, as long as you stay attentive in the small exchanges. A thoughtful message or well-timed call can mean more than a long speech. If single, conversations—online or in your local environment—have extra potential. You may be drawn to someone whose thinking feels neat, articulate and fair.

💰 Money: The Virgo 3rd house energy is good for getting quotes, comparing prices, renegotiating small contracts, or clarifying billing details. Jupiter in your sign still suggests growth over the longer term, but today is about groundwork: accurate information and clear arrangements. Watch impulsive purchases related to commutes, gadgets, or courses; if they genuinely streamline your days, they’re worthwhile, but avoid collecting tools you won’t use.

🧘 Advice: Aim for clean lines—both in your spaces and your schedule. Each clarified detail eases that subtle edge of mental tension.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you handle little tasks is quietly training the universe how much responsibility you’re ready to hold.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun—your ruler—and the Moon are together in Virgo in your 2nd house of resources, voice and self-worth. Hasta nakshatra brings a practical, hands-on approach to money and possessions. You may feel an urge to account for what you have, refine how you use it, and speak more carefully about your value. With Rahu in Aquarius in your 7th and Ketu in Leo in your 1st, relationship mirrors are intense: how others treat you now teaches you a lot about how you treat yourself.

💼 Career: This is an excellent day for any work that involves numbers, contracts, or discussions of compensation. The Sun in your 2nd gives you permission to advocate for your worth with grounded clarity, not ego. If you’ve been undercharging or accepting vague promises, today’s configurations help you ask specific questions. Behind the scenes, Mars and Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th may stir unspoken anxieties about security or recognition; rather than reacting, channel that energy into concrete planning.

❤️ Love: With Ketu moving through your sign, you may feel less inclined to seek attention for its own sake and more interested in authenticity. The 2nd-house focus means the way you speak to loved ones—and about yourself in their presence—matters. If partnered, notice whether you downplay your needs or contributions; small shifts in language can change the dynamic. If single, you may be less attracted to grand gestures and more to those who are consistent, reliable and respectful with money and time.

💰 Money: Today is about stewardship, not spectacle. The Virgo influence supports budgeting, re-evaluating recurring expenses, and perhaps setting aside a modest but firm savings amount. You may also feel compelled to sort physical belongings—selling, donating or repairing items. Financial decisions made in a calm, data-based way now can support you when more extroverted phases arrive.

🧘 Advice: Let your pride express itself through the quality of your choices, not the size of your gestures. Quiet, well-considered moves serve you best under this sky.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your value doesn’t grow when others clap; it grows each time you treat your own efforts as something worth protecting.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon are together in your own sign today, in Hasta nakshatra. This is a personal reset day in the Vedic sense, lighting up your 1st house of body, identity and direction. You may feel both self-aware and a little critical, noticing what’s out of alignment. Mercury, your ruler, in Libra in your 2nd asks you to balance self-reflection with fair appreciation of your strengths. With Mars and Jupiter in Cancer in your 11th, friends and networks may pull on your energy even as you’re trying to recalibrate.

💼 Career: Visibility is moderate but impact is high. You’re likely to approach tasks with extra precision and may naturally slip into the role of the person who “knows how this should be done.” Use that carefully: guide, don’t nitpick. This is a strong day for updating your professional profile, refining how you describe your services, or deciding which responsibilities you want to carry into the next phase. The 11th-house activation suggests thinking about long-term goals and which groups genuinely align with them.

❤️ Love: With your 1st house activated, relationships reflect how you’re feeling about yourself. If partnered, you may crave being seen for your effort and thoughtfulness. Instead of hoping they’ll read your mind, try naming one simple thing you need more of and one thing you truly appreciate. If single, you may feel both selective and slightly self-conscious; don’t let self-critique turn into withdrawal. This is a good time to gently update your own story about what you bring to a relationship.

💰 Money: Mercury in Libra in your 2nd adds a diplomatic tone to money matters. It’s favourable for fair negotiations, splitting costs sensibly, or revising how you present your pricing. Just avoid editing your value downward to keep everyone comfortable. Mars–Jupiter in your 11th could bring opportunities linked to teams, online platforms or communities; distinguish between real prospects and distractions.

🧘 Advice: Use today to make one or two concrete decisions about how you want to show up in the next month, rather than trying to perfect everything at once.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your standards are powerful—just remember they’re meant to shape your life, not shrink you inside it.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon meet in Virgo in your 12th house, drawing your energy inward. Hasta’s organisational quality shows up behind the scenes: you may feel compelled to sort old files, clean hidden corners, or process lingering memories. Your ruler Venus is retrograde in your own sign in Swati, making self-image and personal desires a work in progress. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 6th keeps reminding you that your inner state and your daily responsibilities are now tightly linked.

💼 Career: Outwardly, this may look like an ordinary workday, but the real action is in your private reflections. You may question whether certain roles, routines, or obligations are still worth the energy they demand. Use the 12th-house clarity to observe where you overextend yourself for the sake of harmony. Behind-the-scenes tasks—research, drafting, closing old loops—are well-supported. Avoid launching big new initiatives today; let ideas breathe a little.

❤️ Love: With Venus retrograde in your 1st and the luminaries in your 12th, you’re more aware of unresolved feelings, past relationship patterns, or subtle ways you’ve edited yourself to keep the peace. If partnered, you may need small pockets of solitude to sort your thoughts before you speak; let your partner know it’s about clarity, not distance. If single, memories of past connections may resurface—not to drag you back, but to help you see what you don’t want to repeat.

💰 Money: The 12th house activation often brings attention to hidden or background expenses: subscriptions you forget, fees, or costs tied to avoidance (like last-minute bookings). It’s a good day to quietly list out these small drains and decide what to release. Be conservative about lending money or mixing finances with friends while Venus and Saturn both push you toward sober evaluation.

🧘 Advice: Build in small, intentional pauses during the day—five minutes to breathe, stretch, or simply notice what you’re feeling without judgment.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Stepping back for a moment isn’t losing balance; it’s how you remember what you actually want to be balancing.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon in Virgo activate your 11th house of alliances, audiences and long-term aims. Hasta nakshatra adds a practical, craft-focused edge: you’re encouraged to shape your future plans with your own hands rather than waiting for fate. Mars, your traditional ruler, travels with Jupiter in Cancer in your 9th, opening questions about study, travel or a shift in worldview. Saturn retrograde in Pisces in your 5th keeps joy and responsibility intertwined.

💼 Career: Group dynamics and networks are highlighted. This is a favourable day to review which professional circles actually support your growth, and which simply consume energy. You might refine your presence in online spaces, update profiles, or reach out to a few key contacts with a concrete idea rather than vague “keeping in touch.” With Mars–Jupiter in the 9th, you’re well-supported for work involving teaching, consulting, law, or international links—especially if you focus on the next modest step rather than the entire leap.

❤️ Love: The 11th house theme can bring romantic threads through friendships, communities or shared causes. If partnered, doing something that aligns with both your values—supporting a cause, attending a talk, or planning a future trip—can deepen connection. If single, pay attention to who consistently shows up for you in group settings; someone in your wider circle may hold more significance than you’ve realised. Just take your time; Saturn in the 5th favours slow-building trust over instant fireworks.

💰 Money: Financially, today is more about the long game. The 11th house deals with gains from career and networks, so you might review whether your current path realistically leads to the outcomes you want. It’s a good day to refine goals around income targets or savings milestones. Be measured with spending on entertainment or speculative ventures—the 5th-house Saturn wants play, but with a plan.

🧘 Advice: Focus on building two or three strong bridges instead of trying to keep dozens of loose connections alive.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The people who quietly walk beside your goals are far more valuable than the ones who only clap for the highlight reels.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: With the Sun and Moon joining in Virgo in your 10th house, this is a day when your public role and responsibilities come sharply into focus. Hasta nakshatra gives a meticulous, hands-on approach to your ambitions. Jupiter, your ruler, continues in Cancer in Ashlesha in your 8th, stirring deeper financial and psychological themes behind what you’re trying to achieve. Rahu in Aquarius in your 3rd keeps your mind racing with possibilities and information.

💼 Career: This is one of those transits where your work is noticed—not necessarily through fanfare, but through the sheer reliability and precision you demonstrate. It’s ideal for clarifying expectations with supervisors or clients, tightening timelines, or documenting processes. You may feel more aware than usual of the gap between your current role and your long-term vision; instead of frustration, let that awareness show you which skills or credentials to prioritise next.

❤️ Love: With career so active, relationships might temporarily orbit around your schedule. If partnered, being transparent about demands on your time—and inviting your partner into your planning rather than just apologising—can prevent misunderstandings. If single, you may feel drawn to people who are competent and grounded in their work. Conversations may naturally gravitate toward life direction and ethics rather than pure romance.

💰 Money: The 8th-house Jupiter–Mars combination continues to highlight shared resources, investments and obligations. Today’s Virgo 10th-house focus suggests professional decisions with clear financial implications: negotiating terms, considering a new role, or adjusting your approach to clients. It’s wise to document agreements carefully and avoid mixing personal and professional finances impulsively.

🧘 Advice: Let practicality be your ally, not your enemy. One concrete, well-executed step in your career today will do more for your future than hours of restless imagining.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your vision grows real the moment you can explain it in clear tasks—and are willing to own those tasks in public.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon in Virgo move through your 9th house of higher understanding, long journeys, and belief systems. Hasta nakshatra lends a craftsperson’s attitude to these big themes: instead of abstract philosophy, you’re invited to shape your worldview through practical steps—study, planning, or concrete decisions about your path. Saturn, your ruler, retrograde in Pisces in your 3rd asks you to take your words and commitments seriously.

💼 Career: This is a favourable day for activities that expand your professional horizon: researching courses or certifications, polishing an application, discussing long-term trajectory with a mentor, or mapping out a multi-step project. Work involving teaching, law, publishing, or cross-border connections gets a boost. Communication might feel slower but more deliberate; it’s better to send one well-thought-out message than many rushed ones.

❤️ Love: The 9th-house emphasis can pull your attention toward shared philosophies and future visions. If partnered, you may find yourselves discussing travel, relocation, spiritual paths, or educational plans—yours or your children’s. These conversations can strengthen the bond if you stay open to differences. If single, you might feel attracted to those who stretch your thinking: people from different cultures, disciplines or life stories.

💰 Money: Financially, today favours investments in education, skills and structured long-term plans more than short-term gains. You might also review legal or bureaucratic matters related to money—visas, contracts, insurances, or academic fees. Saturn in the 3rd supports creating a written plan or timeline for bigger goals, even if execution is gradual.

🧘 Advice: Zoom out gently. Let yourself see the bigger map of where you’re heading, then choose one small, realistic action that honours that view.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your stability doesn’t come from standing still; it comes from knowing why you’re walking the path you’ve chosen.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: Sun and Moon join in Virgo in your 8th house, turning the spotlight on shared resources, psychological undercurrents and the parts of life that can’t be handled with surface fixes. Hasta’s precision gives you the capacity to examine complex matters—financial or emotional—with a steady, practical eye. Rahu in your sign (sidereally in Aquarius) continues to stir a desire for reinvention, while Saturn in Pisces in your 2nd insists that changes be grounded in realistic resource management.

💼 Career: Behind-the-scenes aspects of work are emphasised: contracts, confidentiality, research, audits, and any project that requires digging below the obvious. You may uncover a small but important detail others have missed. It’s a good day to clarify terms in collaborations, especially those involving money, intellectual property or shared responsibility. Avoid power games; Virgo in the 8th is about clean, transparent arrangements, not leverage.

❤️ Love: Emotional depth is available, though it may feel more like quiet honesty than dramatic confrontation. If partnered, topics around trust, boundaries, and practical sharing—who handles which responsibilities, how decisions are made—may come up. Approach them as joint problem-solving rather than blame. If single, you may feel drawn to people who carry emotional complexity, but your task is to notice how safe and consistent they feel, not just how intense the connection is.

💰 Money: The 8th-house focus often coincides with an urge to look at loans, debts, insurances, taxes, or inheritances. Today favours gathering data and organising documents rather than rushing into big moves. With Saturn in your 2nd, this is a time to build steady, honest foundations: know what’s yours, what’s shared, and what your real obligations are. Speculative or secretive financial manoeuvres are better postponed.

🧘 Advice: Be willing to look at uncomfortable truths without dramatising them. Clarity is less frightening when you approach it as a set of solvable pieces.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The real power move isn’t control—it’s knowing exactly where you stand and choosing from there.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon in Virgo light up your 7th house of partnership, agreements and open allies or opponents. Hasta nakshatra favours practical cooperation: working with others on something tangible rather than staying in theory. Saturn retrograde in your own sign keeps you in a maturing phase, refining how you show up to commitments. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer in your 5th meanwhile enliven creativity, romance and the desire to share your heart.

💼 Career: Collaborations, client relationships and one-to-one professional interactions are central today. The Virgo influence brings a focus on clear terms, written agreements, and fair division of labour. You may be asked to mediate, refine a proposal, or clarify expectations with a partner. It’s a strong day for reviewing existing contracts or renegotiating aspects that have become lopsided, as long as you stay specific and calm.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes are front and centre. If partnered, you’re likely to notice the mechanics of how the two of you function as a team: who remembers the details, who initiates plans, who handles follow-through. Rather than resenting imbalances, use today to name them neutrally and suggest small adjustments. If single, you may find yourself evaluating potential partners through the lens of practicality: can we actually build a workable life rhythm together?

💰 Money: With your 7th house active and Jupiter–Mars in the 5th, money may intersect with creative projects, children, or shared plans with a partner. It’s a favourable day to spell out financial expectations around joint ventures or romantic plans so that assumptions don’t breed disappointment later. Avoid rushing into financial commitments purely to keep harmony; Saturn in your sign supports calmly saying, “I need to think this through.”

🧘 Advice: Let honesty be gentle but precise. Today’s sky rewards clear agreements that still leave room for warmth and play.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that truly nourish you are the ones where love and logistics can sit at the same table.
